issue.title: Add a Ref Job glossary term

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add a glossary term **Ref Job** (glossary web, new strand), proposed by bob-cli-52.9 note #3 for epic bob-cli-52:

A Ref Job is one durable request to clip a link into the reading queue. It is a JSON file in the spool under `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/bob-cli/ref/jobs/` (pending/, running/, stuck/, done.jsonl). `bob capture` (and Bob Mac Capture through it) queues one per bare-link reference item, and a detached single-flight worker (`bob ref jobs run`) clips it through the shared ingest. It ends as clipped, already in library, already queued, or fell back. A fallback writes the original inbox task plus a ⚠️ note. `bob ref jobs` lists recent jobs. A job is not a ref note: `bob ref scan` writes the note later from the clipped intake PDF. Link to Reference Note, Inbox File, and the bare-link decision record once it exists.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-52 introduced durable ref jobs (bob ref jobs) and its verify phase proposed a glossary term for them (bob-cli-52.9 note #3); no glossary strand defines the term.
